notes: Woman close to camera fills the left of the tiles but the door leaf and right edge stay visible; nobody crosses.
A dark figure seen faintly through the propped door glass during the top row is gone by the middle row; counted as one departure, not certain.
Small dark shapes low behind the door glass in a few tiles could be someone standing outside; no crossing seen.
People close to the camera cover much of the frame; a man in a blue jacket and mask appears in the room mid-strip but his entry direction was not seen.
Masked man in blue jacket walks to the door and is gone; a person in a black beanie appears at the right edge late; another dark figure at the right edge in one tile could not be resolved either way.

Person with backpack close to camera hides the left half; a man in a cap appears beside the door early, and the dark-haired woman hugs people near the door and is not seen afterwards; much movement at the door could not be followed.

A man in black shows up in the room while a couple stands in the doorway, likely an arrival; white-haired woman lingers behind the door glass most of the minute without leaving; several people near the camera could not be traced.
White-haired woman stays behind the door glass all minute; others move between room and camera without crossing the right edge.
Blue-haired woman in polka-dot jacket carrying bags walks from the camera to the door, hugs someone and is gone by the next tile; exit itself not seen.

Man in black unprops and closes the door mid-strip; it reopens briefly in the bottom row as a dark-haired woman goes to the edge; a long-haired woman in a grey coat seems to step out early and return; heads close to camera block the bottom row.

Door now closed and swinging into view; a woman in a dark blazer enters at the end of the top row, a black-haired woman and at least one man in a cap enter in the bottom row; grey-haired woman close to camera hides part of the edge and a group gathers at the door at the end.

Door opens mid-strip as a hooded figure and then a bearded man with a backpack go out; a cluster of people stands at the right edge in the top row and people near the camera block it in the bottom row, so arrivals could be missed.
A group stands talking right at the edge for the whole minute and men close to the camera cover it; no crossing or door leaf seen.
Two women (one with a white shopping bag, one hooded with a mask) walk from the camera to the door, which opens at the end of the top row; a standing group partly covers the edge otherwise.

Busy minute: masked man in blue (seen leaving about ten minutes earlier) holds the door while a woman in a green beanie and several others come in and two people from the camera side go out; door is opened again twice and ends propped open; counts are approximate.
Propped door leaf is in view in the first tile only, then closed; man in tan jacket and cap lingers at the edge handing things to someone just out of view, then walks out with a bag.

Woman close to camera hides the edge for most of the top row; when she moves a white-haired woman in a tan quilted jacket is walking into the room (probably the one who had been waiting at the door), and later a woman in a dark blazer strides in from the right; entries themselves not seen.

Man in grey-tan puffer and cap strides in from the right mid-strip; looks like the man who went out with a bag two minutes earlier. A dark-coated figure near the right edge in the last tile is unresolved.
Man in blue close to camera fills the left of the tiles but the right edge stays open; a man in a black hoodie appears mid-room in the middle row, origin not seen.
Men close to the camera cover the edge in the top row; later a person in a grey coat hovers at the right edge and moves around the room, with no definite crossing.
Someone stands at the lower right edge most of the minute; a woman in a grey coat and a man in black come into view from the right at the very end but look like people already in the room.
Woman in grey coat drifts to the right edge and out of view over the first four tiles; no door leaf seen, so she may only be standing just out of frame.
Woman taking photos stands right at the edge, close to the camera, covering part of it; no crossing seen.
A talk seems to be starting: woman in blazer takes a spot by the wall, audience seated; nobody crosses the right edge.
Woman in blazer stands near the right edge and people photograph her; she slips partly past the edge in a few tiles but does not leave.
Door swings open in the bottom row and a white-haired woman and a grey-haired man come in to hugs; heads close to the camera hide the lower part of the edge, so more may have entered with them.
The couple who came in last minute are greeted close to the camera, covering the edge in the top row; afterwards the man stands near the edge in a grey T-shirt; no crossing seen.
Man in blue stands at the right edge for the first two rows then walks into the room; people pose for photos; no door crossing seen.
Man in blue walks to the right edge and out of view early in the bottom row; no door leaf seen, and he had been standing just at the edge earlier, so he may not have left the room.

Man in blue (back at the edge, so his 'departure' in the previous strip was probably not a real exit) opens the door late in the middle row and it stays propped; a man with a backpack and a woman in a tan coat appear at the door then, counted as arrivals though direction is uncertain.

Door propped open; a tall man in a varsity-style jacket stands in front of the door area all minute, with a yellow-beanie head and a hand with a phone glimpsed behind him; no crossing could be confirmed.

People stand in front of the propped door for two rows; late in the middle row a woman in a tan coat goes to the door and the leaf is then closed; a grey-haired man in a light blue top is at the right edge from the start of the bottom row and may be a new arrival or the earlier man in blue without his cap.
People take turns posing for photos by the wall at the right edge and step slightly in and out of frame; none of it looks like door traffic.
Photo-taking continues with many people milling at the right edge and stepping in and out of frame; several tiles are corrupted by video glitches; no door leaf seen.
Photos and milling near the right edge; an older couple in tan jackets with bags gathers by the edge in the bottom row as if preparing to leave, but nobody is seen going out.

Man in grey-tan puffer carrying bags stands at the right edge, close to the camera, then goes out as the door edge shows in the bottom row; the woman in the tan quilted jacket may have left with him but was hidden by the group.

Door leaf shows for one tile in the bottom row with the man in the tan jacket and cap at it, apparently coming back in after leaving a minute earlier (could instead be leaving again); woman close to the camera hides the lower edge most of the minute. The tan-quilted woman is still in the room, so she did not leave in the previous strip.
